lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno stood on the diving board,
His feet froze into ice, he roared!
Kiki said, that's not the deal,
Cold feet means nerves are what you feel!
[chorus]
Cold feet, cold feet,
Nervous now, want to retreat!
Cold feet, cold feet,
Take a breath, you can't be beat!
[verse]
It means you're scared to do a thing,
Before a jump, a show, or swing,
You almost want to back away,
But brave hearts take that step today!
[chorus]
Cold feet, cold feet,
Nervous now, want to retreat!
Cold feet, cold feet,
Brave it out and feel the beat!
[outro]
So when you're nervous, feet like ice,
Be brave, jump in, it's really nice!
